## Load reasoning (in the rationales)
- Category integrity forces FA, AG, PDE, DG, RT, HA into single groups, and scheme theory (5 batches) into a 3+2 split. The cheapest three-batch scheme subset is {5,7,8} = 145, so **max group ≥ 145**; HA = 44 is cap-locked, so **spread ≥ 101**. This partition attains both exactly — an exhaustive enumeration of the 12,000 legal assignments (over the forced structure, via a temporary scratch script now deleted) confirms 145/101 is the optimum and 68 is the minimum crossing count among those optima. The 145-item scheme floor and the 137/44 extremes are indivisible; they cannot be rebalanced by later authoring, as stated in the rationales.
- Among the tied optima I chose the one whose unforced pairings have real thematic ties: {26,27} (Green functions/harmonic measure, Jensen–Nevanlinna) with Markov-chain recurrence/hitting times, and {28,29} (Riemann surfaces, dbar complex) with classification of surfaces, which also keeps the declared edge 28→10 inside one group.

## One contradiction worth recording
The dispatch text says "at most nine groups", but 30 batches at ≤3 per group require **exactly 10 groups**; nine could cover at most 27 batches. The validator's actual cap (`tools/autopilot/src/capacity.mjs`: `MAX_GROUPS = ceil(30/3) = 10`) accepts this partition and rejects any uncovered batch, and the gate passed. No content was reviewed, no other files were written, and nothing outside my write scope was touched.
